$comment: The seed listing. Source: AstraPlugins/examples/dice-roller/plugin.toml at version 0.1.1. Everything here is copied from that manifest by hand today; from Phase 3 the bot reads it out of the attested bundle instead, and a human never retypes a field that the bytes already carry.
name: Dice Roller
summary: Roll dice and flip coins, with actions and triggers for the command editor.
description: Rolls dice of any size and flips coins. Exposes a tool the assistant can call in conversation, actions the command editor can chain, and triggers other commands can fire on. Ships as the smallest complete example of an Astra plugin: one tool, one action, one trigger, and a config field.
